performance.notes: Final one-pair Virtua Racing timing is a sanity measurement, not a stable estimate. Intermediate cold-helper timing overlapped compilation and is excluded. Native framebuffer, PCM and full serialized states matched.

limits: Opaque fetch backing and pre-existing prefetch without provenance remain logical; plain text imports and v1 projects retain logical semantics.
SSP data event addresses use debugger-assigned RAM0/RAM1 ranges; unsupported PM modes/raw register traffic do not emit fabricated accesses.
Firecore raster is a VRAM snapshot, not pixel provenance for mid-line writes.
Pixel provenance/profiling, scanline/IRQ run controls and reverse-instruction stepping remain deferred.
